content.title: Verify design agreed: usersRegenerate token override
content.description: Sync tracker — verify that library-developer and webapp-developer agree on the usersRegenerate API design. Read the review comment. If agreed, unblock implementation. If concerns were raised, create fix+re-review tasks and loop until both agree.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqe2743x4q transitioned to done

content.content:
## Design agreement: VERIFIED — AGREED ✅

Both sides of the joint design concur. Implementation is unblocked.

**Provider design (mqe274dj8z):** Option A — add optional `{ token }` param to `usersRegenerate`, forwarding into the existing `resolveAuthor` call (tracker.ts:1895). The self-service check stays as-is; with a token supplied, resolveAuthor validates it and returns the owner, then the self-service check confirms owner == target. Fully backward compatible, ~3 lines + JSDoc. Rejected the alternative (relaxing the open-mode self-service check) because it only patches open mode and weakens security.

**Consumer review (mqe2743x4q, webapp-developer):** APPROVE — 'Implementation can proceed. Green light from the consumer side.' Endorsed the options-object form, confirmed the webapp's existing result/error handling needs no changes, and validated that error handling (wrong token → 401) is preserved.

The consumer's two notes — open-mode token lookup coupling and the Phase 4 e2e assertion flip (197–216) — are explicitly scoped as **webapp-side implementation** planning concerns for the sibling webapp deliverable, NOT objections to this library API. They do not block agreement.

Marking this sync tracker done → auto-clears the blockage on the Implement task (mqe2745ekb). Reassigning Implement to library-developer so the now-unblocked work flows to the correct role.
